statement: Rolling-restart failed samples can be classified without timeout hand-waving by deterministic replay/emulation of owner wake, queue drain, publication visibility, and operation workflow progress; the classifier distinguishes observed progress before budget exhaustion from stuck and insufficient-evidence states, with fixtures covering the latest publication_missing_active_node stall and at least one known drain/in-flight stall.

doneWhenSealed.closure: The classifier/emulator is replayable and tested; this Quest does not claim rolling-restart product stability, does not close run4, and does not mutate run4's sealed statistical bar.
doneWhenSealed.progressWitnessRule: A verdict may be observed_progressing_budget_exhausted only when a post-action witness shows queue or in-flight depth decreasing, reconcile execution starting or completing, publication epoch/readback changing, missingPublished shrinking, or CDC lag decreasing across timestamps.
acceptance: Given test-output/reports/stat-gate-20260629T045155Z-run1.report.json, the analyzer/emulator emits exactly one structured verdict from the requiredVerdicts set.
The verdict includes owner, boundary, enabled action, last progress timestamp, queue state, publication delta, and evidence path.
A fixture goes red if owner_reconcile_enqueued plus nonzero owner queue depth is classified as observed_progressing_budget_exhausted without a later progress witness.
Deterministic fixtures prove classifier behavior for synthetic slow-progress and true-stuck publication cases.
At least one known drain/in-flight stall fixture is classified through the same evidence model.
Implementation changes are limited to instrumentation/analyzer/test artifacts unless a separate product Quest is opened.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not mutate rolling-restart-run4-drain-residual's sealed doneWhen or use this Quest to close its statistical product-stability claim.
Do not classify a failed run as observed_progressing_budget_exhausted from enqueue, backlog, retry scheduling, or timeout extension alone; require a later progress witness.
Mechanism classification must be proven by replay/emulation and deterministic fixtures before any new rolling-restart gate is used for certification.
